dialogue.origin: こんばんは、本日はどうぞよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: お時間になりましたら、お声掛けさせていただきますね
dialogue.content: I’ll let you know when our time is up.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは相談員です相談にお越しいただき有難うございます
dialogue.content: Good evening, I’m the counselor. Thank you for coming in.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 家庭の事と仕事の事で悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm worried about things with my family and my job.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねもう少し詳しくお聞きしたいと思いますが
dialogue.content: I see. I’d like to hear a little more about that, if you're comfortable.

dialogue.origin: 家庭と仕事のどちからでも話しやすい方からで大丈夫ですのでお話しいただけますか
dialogue.content: You can start with whichever is easier to talk about, either your family or your job. Could you tell me more?

dialogue.origin: 2週間前に、上司から、転勤を打診されました
dialogue.content: Two weeks ago, my boss offered me a transfer.

dialogue.origin: 昇進なんですけど
dialogue.content: It's a promotion, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 行き先がアメリカで、
dialogue.content: The destination is the United States, and...

dialogue.origin: 妻は大反対なんです
dialogue.content: my wife is completely against it.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・
dialogue.content: Oh, I see...

dialogue.origin: 行くなら1人で行ってと言われて
dialogue.content: She told me that if I go, I should go alone.

dialogue.origin: ええっ・・
dialogue.content: Oh...

dialogue.origin: それは寂しいですよね、、
dialogue.content: That would be lonely, wouldn’t it?

dialogue.origin: コロナの事もあって、絶対行かないと
dialogue.content: She says she absolutely won't go, partly because of COVID.

dialogue.origin: 分からなくは無いんですけど
dialogue.content: I can understand that, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 困りました
dialogue.content: I’m at a loss.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、できれば一緒に行きたいですよね・・
dialogue.content: I understand. You'd want to go together if possible, wouldn't you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご家族は他にはいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any other family members?

dialogue.origin: はい。5歳の娘がいます
dialogue.content: Yes. We have a five-year-old daughter.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご自身はどんなところが困るなとお感じですか
dialogue.content: What aspects of this feel most difficult for you?

dialogue.origin: 色々とあるんですが先ずは家族と離れてしまう事ですね。何年行くか分からないので、妻子を日本に残していくのは考えられないんです
dialogue.content: There are several things, but the first is being separated from my family. I don’t know how many years I’d be gone, so I can’t imagine leaving my wife and child in Japan.

dialogue.origin: いつ帰ってこられる分からないと、家族を残していくのはとても心配ですよね・・・
dialogue.content: Not knowing when you might be able to return must make the thought of leaving your family behind very worrying...

dialogue.origin: ですよね
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうだと思います
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, I can imagine.

dialogue.origin: 他にはどんなことがありますか
dialogue.content: What else is on your mind?

dialogue.origin: はい。会社の方に、海外転勤を断ると、今後の仕事に影響すると思うんです。それに、仕事は、以前からやってみたかったやりがいがあるものですし、転勤の話は断りたく無いし
dialogue.content: Yes. At work, I think turning down an overseas transfer will affect my future career. Plus, the work itself is rewarding and something I've wanted to do for a long time, so I don't want to turn down the offer.

dialogue.origin: かと言って、国内でも1人で暮らした事がないので、1人でアメリカで暮らすのは無理ですよ。
dialogue.content: That being said, I've never even lived alone in Japan, so living by myself in the U.S. is out of the question for me.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、いきなりアメリカで一人暮らしはつらすぎますよね・・・
dialogue.content: I can see that. Suddenly living alone in the U.S. would be too difficult, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 仕事はとてもやりたいことなのに、奥様が大反対となるととても悩ましいですよね・・
dialogue.content: It must be very distressing to have a job you really want to do, only for your wife to be so strongly against it...

dialogue.origin: 困りました
dialogue.content: I’m really stuck.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: これまでは普段ご家族とはどんなふうに関わってこられましたか
dialogue.content: Up to now, how have you typically been involved with your family?

dialogue.origin: と、言いますと？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by that?

dialogue.origin: 例えば、休日とかに奥様や娘さんとどんなふうにすごしておられるか　とか日常のことでけっこうなのですが　よかったらお聞かせいただけますか
dialogue.content: For example, how do you spend your days off with your wife and daughter? Just everyday things are fine, if you'd be willing to share.

dialogue.origin: 他の家庭はわかりませんが、自分で言うのも変ですが、しっかり関われていると思います。幼稚園にもお迎えに行ったりしますし
dialogue.content: I don't know about other families, and it feels strange to say this myself, but I think I'm very involved. I even go to pick my daughter up from kindergarten.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それはとても素敵なお父さんですよね！
dialogue.content: I see. You sound like a wonderful father!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: それだけしっかりと家族の関係が出来ているからこそ離れたくないと感じてしますよね・・・
dialogue.content: It's because you have such a strong family bond that you don't want to be separated, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい。一、二年ならまだしも、何年になるか分からないなんて
dialogue.content: Yes. If it were just for a year or two, that would be one thing, but not knowing how many years it could be...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、、それは寂しすぎますよね、、
dialogue.content: I understand... that would be too lonely...

dialogue.origin: 無理ですよね
dialogue.content: It's impossible, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 奥様の心配は主にコロナの関係でしょうか、他には何かおっしゃっていましたか？
dialogue.content: Is your wife's worry mainly related to COVID, or has she mentioned anything else?

dialogue.origin: そうですね…子どもの幼稚園のことと、両親の事が気になるみたいです
dialogue.content: Well... she seems to be concerned about our child's kindergarten and her parents.

dialogue.origin: コロナは勿論ですが
dialogue.content: COVID is a concern too, of course.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ご両親のことはどんなことが気になるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What are her concerns about her parents?

dialogue.origin: 妻は1人娘なので、両親の老後は自分が世話をするとずっと思ってきてるので
dialogue.content: My wife is an only child, so she has always felt that she would be the one to take care of her parents in their old age.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: That's understandable.

dialogue.origin: アメリカにずっと行くとかあり得ないって言います
dialogue.content: She says going to the U.S. long-term is out of the question.

dialogue.origin: そんなご事情もおありなんですね、、
dialogue.content: So there's that aspect to the situation as well...

dialogue.origin: はい。妻の気持ちも分かるんですけどね
dialogue.content: Yes. I do understand how she feels, though.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、それが分かっていると「絶対ついてきて」とは何とも言いづらいですよね・・・
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm. Knowing that, it must be hard to say, "You absolutely have to come with me," doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですけどね。でも、こちらも困るし
dialogue.content: That's true. But it puts me in a difficult position, too.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、本当にそうですよね、、
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, I can certainly see that...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 実際に、奥様にご自身の絶対に着いてきて欲しいお気持は伝えている感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Have you actually conveyed to your wife how much you want her to come with you?

dialogue.origin: はい。こっちも必死なので
dialogue.content: I'm desperate, so I have.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・でも大反対は変わらず・・・
dialogue.content: I see... but she's still strongly against it...

dialogue.origin: それは悩んでしまうのも無理ないですよね・・・
dialogue.content: It's no wonder you're so distressed by this...

dialogue.origin: 困ってしまって
dialogue.content: I just don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: このことを誰かに相談したことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to anyone else about this?

dialogue.origin: 友人には少し
dialogue.content: A little bit, to a friend.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、一度赴任したらいつ帰ってこられるか分からないというのは何か会社の方で決まっていることなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: By the way, is it a company rule that once you're assigned, it's unclear when you'll be able to return?

dialogue.origin: はい。上司に言われました。
dialogue.content: Yes. That’s what my boss told me.

dialogue.origin: アメリカでの責任者みたいになるので
dialogue.content: It's because I'll be in a leadership position in the U.S.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、それは本当にすごいチャンスですね！
dialogue.content: I see. That's a truly amazing opportunity!

dialogue.origin: はい。できたら、このチャンスを逃したくないんです
dialogue.content: Yes. If possible, I don't want to let this chance slip away.

dialogue.origin: わがままでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is that selfish of me?

dialogue.origin: うんうん、ずっと頑張ってきてつかんだチャンスですものね、手放したくないって思いますよね！
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, it's a chance you've worked so hard for. Of course you wouldn't want to let it go!

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: 私はそんなふうには思いませんが、そんなふうに感じられるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I don't think it's selfish at all, but is that how you're feeling?

dialogue.origin: わがままかなって・・・
dialogue.content: That maybe you're being selfish...

dialogue.origin: あ、そちらですね。そうですね、家族を顧みない夫、父親なんかな、と思う時もあります
dialogue.content: Oh, you mean that. Yes, sometimes I wonder if I'm being a husband and father who doesn't consider his family.

dialogue.origin: 実際、妻は大反対ですし
dialogue.content: After all, my wife is completely against it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、今の置かれている状況がたまたまご自身は仕事でのチャンスをしっかり生かしたい、でも奥様はコロナや娘さん、ご両親のこともあり反対な状況ということですが、
dialogue.content: I see... So, the situation is that you want to make the most of this career opportunity, whereas your wife is opposed because of her concerns about COVID, your daughter, and her parents.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: これまで、ご自身が家族と大切に関わってこられたことは揺るぎないと思いますが、いかがですか
dialogue.content: However, I believe the fact that you have always cared for and been deeply involved with your family up to this point is unshakable. What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: そう思いたいです。
dialogue.content: I’d like to think so.

dialogue.origin: ええ、お話をお聞きしていて、そこは信じていいと私は思います
dialogue.content: Yes. From what you’ve shared, I think that's something you can believe in.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ここまでお話をお聞かせいただきましたが、今のところでご自身としては何かこうしたいというのはありますか？
dialogue.content: Now that you've shared all this with me, do you have any thoughts on what you would like to do at this point?

dialogue.origin: 理想は、アメリカに一緒に行きたいんです。でも、行かないと言われて…もう、どうしたらいいのか
dialogue.content: Ideally, I want us to go to the U.S. together. But she says she won't go... I just don't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、やっぱり大切な家族と一緒に行きたいですよね・・・
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, of course you want to go with your precious family...

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: ここまでで私の感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May I share my impressions from our conversation so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご自身は、娘さんの幼稚園の行事にも参加したりして、家族ととても大切に関わってこられました
dialogue.content: You've been very involved with your family, even participating in your daughter's kindergarten events.

dialogue.origin: 仕事でもしっかりと取組み、今回アメリカの責任者という大役を打診されています
dialogue.content: You’ve also worked diligently, and now you’ve been offered the major role as the person in charge in the U.S.

dialogue.origin: 本当に家庭に仕事に一生懸命頑張ってこられたと思います
dialogue.content: I truly believe you've worked incredibly hard, both at home and at work.

dialogue.origin: はたあ
dialogue.content: Ah...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ですが、今コロナの状況や娘さんのこと、ご両親のこともあり奥さんは反対されており、大変困っている状況です
dialogue.content: However, due to the current situation with COVID, your daughter, and her parents, your wife is opposed, and you find yourself in a very difficult position.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 1つご提案なのですが、
dialogue.content: I have a suggestion.

dialogue.origin: ご自身のどうしても家族についてきて欲しいというお気持を、信頼できる方 例えば奥さんのご両親とかに入ってもらってもう一度気持ちを伝えあう場を持つというのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How about creating an opportunity to share your feelings again, perhaps with a trusted third party present, like your wife's parents, to help convey how much you want your family to come with you?

dialogue.origin: そうですね…妻の両親をこの状態で入れるのはどうかな…
dialogue.content: Hmm... I'm not sure about involving my wife's parents in this situation...

dialogue.origin: 夫婦間で話すのは無理でしょうか…
dialogue.content: Would it be impossible to just talk it over between the two of us...?

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、そう思われるのですね心配かけたくはないですよね
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how you feel. You don't want to worry them, right?

dialogue.origin: 夫婦間いいですね
dialogue.content: Talking it over just between the two of you sounds like a good idea.

dialogue.origin: 仲は悪くないです。意見が違うだけで
dialogue.content: We're not on bad terms. We just have a difference of opinion.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、本当にそうですよね！
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, that's absolutely right!

dialogue.origin: もう一度、お互いの気持ちを伝えあって整理するというのが必要になってくると思いますちなみにもう会社への返事の期限は近いのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I think it’s important to share and sort through your feelings with each other once more. By the way, is the deadline to respond to the company approaching?

dialogue.origin: 後1か月あります。
dialogue.content: I have one month left.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、といってもこれほど大事な問題なので時間はあるようでないですよね、、
dialogue.content: I see. But with such an important issue, a month can feel like no time at all, can't it?

dialogue.origin: はい。結構焦ってます
dialogue.content: Yes. I'm feeling quite pressured.

dialogue.origin: 大事なのは、もう一度お互いの気持ちを伝えあうということですが、今度ははじめは出来るだけ奥様のお話を聴いてあげてすべて吐き出していただき、そのうえでご自身のお気持を伝えるとよいかなと思います
dialogue.content: The key is to share your feelings with each other again. This time, I suggest you start by listening to your wife as much as possible, letting her get everything out first, and then sharing your own feelings after that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: その上で夫婦で決めた決断がベストだと思います。決してどちらか一人の意見ではなく、二人で決めることだと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: After that, I believe the best decision will be the one you make together as a couple. It shouldn't be the opinion of just one person, but something you both decide on. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: はい。分かりました。
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand.

dialogue.origin: 是非、お話してみてください
dialogue.content: Please, do try talking it over.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I will.

dialogue.origin: これからも大切なご家族と仲良く暮らしてくことを心から応援しております
dialogue.content: I'll be sincerely rooting for you to continue living happily with your precious family.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 家族思いのあなたならきっと出来ると思います！
dialogue.content: I'm sure that someone as family-oriented as you can do it!

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それでは本日のご相談これで終了とさせていただきますが、よろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: Well then, I'd like to conclude today's session, if that's alright with you.

dialogue.origin: はい。ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 大事なお話をしていただき有難うございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing your important story with me.

dialogue.origin: それでは失礼いたします
dialogue.content: Goodbye for now.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでした！時間オーバーすみませんでした）
dialogue.content: (Great work! Sorry for going over time.)

dialogue.origin: (大丈夫です)
dialogue.content: (No problem.)

dialogue.origin: （またご一緒の時あまりたらよろしくお願いします。それでは失礼いたします。）
dialogue.content: (I look forward to working with you again. Goodbye.)

topic.sub: 転勤に関する意見の相違
